title: Renal-context bicarbonate information and grip strength: a negative incremental prediction test in two NHANES cycles
abstract: Adding a bicarbonate-by-log-creatinine product to a flexible sex-specific routine-measure model did not improve combined grip prediction: source grouped-CV MSE gain -0.042307, second-cycle gain -0.214648 kg² (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-2.932830,0.384457]). The registered improvement criterion was not met. Source n=1849; target n=2096. Target baseline/augmented MSE=122.297729/122.512378 kg². This retrospective cross-cycle analysis does not establish equivalence, causal effects, or untouched external validation.
